releases.name: Alchemy Factory
releases.summary:
A medieval sandbox blending alchemy, automation & shopkeeping!

As a magic apprentice, build your empire of automated production lines crafting potions, metals, and jewels. Rise from a humble shop owner to an industry-dominating alchemy magnate!

releases.name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
releases.summary: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival-sandbox game set on an exuberant planet – Sota7. Explore its vast world and face challenges on your bioengineering journey. Crossbreed plants or animals, gather resources, craft items, and conduct experiments in order to develop new species.

releases.name: Voldark
releases.summary: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

releases.name: TRUDGE
releases.summary: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

releases.name: Let Me Poo!
releases.summary:
A contract with fine print and a hateful landlord leave a man about to explode.

Let Me Poo! is an incremental clicker where you headbutt through endless walls to reach the toilet. Face the ultimate urgency before it's too late!

releases.name: Capitalize
releases.summary: Financial life sim from 18 to retirement: job, budget, housing, broker (ETFs, stocks, gold…), business & IPO, local modes + online career. Learn compounding and the 4% rule by playing.

releases.name: Of Nooks and Nonsense: A Pirate Hidden Object Game
releases.summary:
In Of Nooks and Nonsense: A Pirate Hidden Object Game, you explore a moment in chaos and calamity out on the seas. And through the haze of hand drawn art and delightful music you are tasked with finding 100 things. 

They are out there. Its up to you to find them.

releases.name: aMazeing 98
releases.summary: Explore procedurally generated mazes in a retro first-person adventure inspired by late-1990s computer graphics. Unlock new texture packs, discover strange encounters, and race to improve your best time.

releases.name: Desk Top Racer
releases.summary: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this idle racing management game. Acquire cars, equip parts, and compete online against other players. Win championships and expand your garage through Mastery, Collections, and new rewards.

releases.name: Defend the Dragon Palace!
releases.summary: If you like Windows Solitaire, you're going to love this app!So easy to use: Solitaire has been built specifically for your  iPad to bring you the best card game experience ever… for you to fall in love with it.Have fun with it!

releases.name: OminouSushi
releases.summary: A quiet anomaly slips onto the conveyor belt. Drop sushi, merge matching pieces, and evolve them as you chase a high score—but “ominous sushi” arrive without warning. Spot them before they fall, or the belt speeds up toward game over. Merge, observe, and trust no sushi.

releases.name: CoAnnCo
releases.summary: Cute Rice Ball Friends Co-operative Action! Four players join forces to dig into the gimmicks of the map and escape the stage. Will you be able to show off your perfect chemistry with your friends or will you be a trawler?

releases.name: Carajito
releases.summary: A horde-survival roguelite where even your win condition is random. Mow down tons of absurd enemies, forge an arsenal that gets weirder every round, sign shady contracts and push your luck at the shop. Survive the chaos… before it brings out the worst in you.

releases.name: Anvil and Alembic
releases.summary: The player operates a business that owns stores and apartments in a city. Using dice, the game relies more on the speed and innovativeness of the players go against other players in order to gain victory.Support to play from 2 to 4 players and play with other players or with robots, the primary objective of most levels is to accumulate the most wealth.

releases.name: Might & Poison Mushroom
releases.summary: Memory Trip is an addictive memory game variant for kids and adults - simply for everyone!Features:- A variety of 30 levels in 3 worlds (fruits, flowers, animals, home items)- Up to 28 tiles on one screen- Relaxing guitar background music- Each level's player progress and best time automatically saved- Highly detailed Retina graphicsBecome a Memory Trip Master today!

releases.name: Trouble Thief
releases.summary: Steal your way through 30 levels. Just pick up the loot and carry it back to the safe zone, no problem. Each level has very challenging time trials and a no-hit challenge. The game is mainly designed around beating the levels as fast as possible.

releases.name: Pegture
releases.summary: Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.
